role: simulator QA and known-control qualification only; no candidate selection or confirmation
assignment: dataset stream = phase offset + cell group * 2048 + replicate; voxel/run noise = successive nextRNGSubStream jumps within dataset stream. Record six state words plus RNG header. No reuse across phase, cell, replicate, voxel or run.
initialization: Exact stationary AR(2) pair from independent normal draws using analytic 2x2 covariance, followed by fresh per-time innovations. Innovation variance 1.

qa.rule: Every standardized across-dataset mean must lie in +/- qnorm(1-alpha/(2*M))/sqrt(N); every across-dataset variance must lie in qchisq(c(alpha/(2*M),1-alpha/(2*M)),N-1)/(N-1). Apply to every innovation position, stationary noise position, normalized plus/minus pairs for lags 1..4 and all voxel/run pairs at matched positions. M=1000000 fixed conservative ceiling; abort if exceeded. No fitted outcomes before QA passes.
qa.legacy_negative_control: Park-Miller affine dataset spacing 7919, long-cell null second-run time 140 (845th Gaussian): must fail the same mean bound.

control_acceptance.AR_mean_bias_rule: |bias| + qt(0.95, n-1) * sd/sqrt(n) <= 0.04 for each lag
control_acceptance.variance_ratio_rule: 90% percentile dataset-bootstrap interval of mean reported null variance / empirical null-estimate variance

failure_policy: Retain all refusals and missing slots; no redraw, reseeding or revised bounds after outcomes. QA failure prevents control generation. Control failure does not admit scientific inference.
